title: Advanced Paste can leave Shift stuck with Caps Lock → Ctrl remap

judgment.rationale: The report isolates the bug to the interaction between Advanced Paste and a Caps Lock → Ctrl remap, and Advanced Paste explicitly releases and restores modifiers using GetAsyncKeyState before and after injected input.
evidence: Disabling Advanced Paste removes the problem while keeping the remap.
The trigger is the exact Ctrl+Shift+V flow that Advanced Paste handles.
AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp releases and restores Ctrl/Shift/Win/Alt via GetAsyncKeyState and SendInput.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a design pass around modifier-state capture and pair it with a maintainer-side repro on the remapped hotkey.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix currently covers modifier-state mismatch between Advanced Paste injection and remapped modifier keys.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste can leave Shift logically pressed after Ctrl+Shift+V when Keyboard Manager remaps Caps Lock to Ctrl.
known_information: The issue reproduces only when Advanced Paste is enabled.
The physical combination is Caps Lock + Shift + V.
Pressing Caps Lock + Shift again clears the stuck state.
inferences: The fault likely sits in logical modifier restore, not clipboard content handling.
A remapped modifier makes post-injection GetAsyncKeyState a poor proxy for logical state.
issue_context.analysis: The owning code is narrow and the module interaction is already isolated, so the issue is ready for an actionable design plus maintainer repro.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the issue body and related duplicate references.
Reviewed AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp and confirmed the send/copy path explicitly releases and restores modifiers via GetAsyncKeyState and SendInput.

comment.body: Approve a focused Advanced Paste modifier-state design pass for Issue 50127.

actions.label: Reproduce Caps→Ctrl stuck-Shift path
actions.note: Validate modifier cleanup with a remapped Ctrl source.

reproduce.version: PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer current main build
prerequisites: Map Caps Lock to Ctrl in Keyboard Manager.
Open an app where Shift-click behavior is easy to see.
steps: Press the physical Caps Lock + Shift + V combination so Advanced Paste handles Ctrl+Shift+V.
Immediately click in another app and check whether Shift remains logically pressed.
Press and release Caps Lock + Shift again to confirm the issue clears the same way the reporter described.
reproduce.expected_result: Advanced Paste should dismiss without leaving Shift or Ctrl logically held.

proposed_fixes.title: Capture and restore logical modifiers explicitly for Advanced Paste
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Advanced Paste infers which modifiers to release and restore from live physical key state. With Caps Lock remapped to Ctrl, physical keys and logical modifier state can diverge, leaving Shift logically down after the paste flow completes.
plan: Capture the triggering modifier state once at activation instead of recomputing it after injection.
Differentiate synthetic release/restore events from the user’s original logical modifiers when a remapped modifier is involved.
Add a cleanup path that guarantees Shift/Ctrl are not left logically pressed after dismissal.
verification: Reproduce with Caps Lock mapped to Ctrl and verify Ctrl+Shift+V no longer leaves Shift logically down.
Verify the normal Win+Shift+V flow still works.

confidence.rationale: The interaction is tightly scoped to modifier injection, but the final cleanup strategy still needs validation.

design_decision.reason: Actionable design retained without full expansion.

confidence.rationale: Code path is narrow; exact cleanup fix still needs validation.
